{"text":"ItemID: unavailable; Title: Weird Scenes Inside the Gold Mine; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The Doors fit my classic-rock interests, but I am more interested in blues today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Different Shades Of Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Blues guitar fits my recent Clapton and Hendrix listening; this is the one I would try now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Down Where the Spirit Meets the Bone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its roots-oriented songwriting appeals to me, but I would leave it for another visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Dust Bowl; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues-rock sound appeals, but I would try just one Joe Bonamassa album this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: I Still Do; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: I enjoyed exploring Clapton through Old Sock, but today I would choose a different artist.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Wings Over America; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The classic-rock connection interests me, though a lengthy live album is not my first choice today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Duets: Re-Working The Catalogue; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A collection of duet reinterpretations does not match my current interest in guitar-led blues.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: You And Me; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: More blues guitar is appealing, but I would save this until after trying Different Shades Of Blue.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Atmospheric instrumental rock is less appealing to me right now than songs with vocals and blues guitar.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Ashes & Dust Feat. Railroad Earth; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rootsy direction sounds interesting alongside my recent listening, but I would not choose another album today."}
